'''Gliz''' was a technological yet swinging genre of [[Music/Legends|music]] very popular in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was not to be confused with [[glitz]].<ref name="ROTM">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref>
